insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Room rent eligibility is referenced as per Policy Schedule; specific category/limit not stated in wording text

icu.note: ICU charges covered under inpatient care but specific cap not stated in wording; subject to Policy Schedule

copayment.note: Co-payment percentage is specified in Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance; not stated in wording. Does not apply to ambulance or sub-limit claims.

sub_limits.display: Many sub-limits (cataract, knee, CABG, angioplasty, hernia, etc.)
sub_limits.note: Annexure III lists sub-limits: e.g. Cataract ₹26,000/eye, TKR unilateral ₹1,09,000, CABG ₹1,45,000, Angioplasty ₹1,45,000, Hernioplasty ₹18,000–₹43,000, Hip replacement ₹1,09,000–₹29,000, Hysterectomy ₹72,000, Valve replacement ₹1,09,000, and more

deductible.note: Deductible is defined in the policy but actual amount is per Policy Schedule; not stated in wording

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disease waiting period is 36 months; reducible via portability credits

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific waiting period defined as up to 36 months for specified diseases/treatments (Section 2.1.41)

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are explicitly excluded under Standard Exclusion Code-Excl18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative bonus is defined in the policy (Section 2.1.7) but rate and maximum are not stated in the wording; subject to Policy Schedule

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days before admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge

day_care.note: Day care covered for procedures listed in Annexure IV (536 listed procedures)

domiciliary.note: Home Care/Domiciliary Treatment covered up to limit in Policy Schedule; medical/ambulatory devices at home not covered

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment is explicitly excluded under Specific Exclusion 4.2.6; policy covers Allopathic treatment only per Preamble

organ_donor.note: Living donor harvesting expenses covered under Section 3.7; donor's hospital stay, screening, pre/post-hosp expenses excluded

ambulance.note: Emergency ground ambulance within India covered; non-network provider capped at amount in Policy Schedule; one transfer per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments covered (Section 3.3); robotic surgeries capped at ₹1 lakh except prostatectomy, cardiac, nephrectomy, malignancy cases

consumables.note: Annexure I lists extensive non-payable consumables (gloves, nebulisation kit, masks, etc.); no consumables rider mentioned

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatments in India only (Preamble); all claims payable in India in Indian Rupees only (Section 5.2.6)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim/policy contestable except for established fraud

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes; coverage available during grace period

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies only, not on renewals

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI norms; credits for PED, specific waiting periods, moratorium transferable

notable_exclusions.display: AYUSH treatments, OPD, sleep disorders, STIs (non-HIV), external congenital anomaly, dental (non-accident/cancer), multifocal lens, conflict/disaster

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons mentioned in the policy wording
